rules.d: Materials under MIT, Apache-2.0, CC BY-SA or CC0 may be mirrored, translated and embedded on this platform with attribution and the original license file. Non-commercial variants (CC BY-NC-SA) may be hosted only in a non-commercial context.

Officially free books that remain copyrighted — Goodfellow, ESL, MML, Murphy, Sutton & Barto, the Jurafsky & Martin draft, Prince's Understanding Deep Learning — and university course sites are linked to their official homes, never re-hosted.
We do not link to 'free PDF' repositories of commercial textbooks. If a book is not free from its authors or publisher, it is not in this library.
Open model weights carry their own licenses and use policies. Lessons that use them ask you to check the license before deploying.

sections.title: Complete open curricula
sections.summary: Full courses with lessons, notebooks and quizzes under permissive licenses — the fastest way to stand up a real syllabus.

items.title: AI for Beginners
items.note: 24 lessons across symbolic AI, neural networks, vision and NLP with TensorFlow and PyTorch notebooks, quizzes and translations.

items.title: ML for Beginners
items.note: 26 classical machine-learning lessons with scikit-learn: regression, classification, clustering, NLP, time series and reinforcement learning.

items.title: Generative AI for Beginners
items.note: 21 lessons on prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, agents, fine-tuning and responsible use, with a companion repo of runnable samples.

items.title: AI Agents for Beginners
items.note: 18 lessons on agent design patterns, tool use, agentic RAG, memory, protocols, local agents and security.

items.title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
items.license: Videos & prose: link only · fastbook code: GPL-3.0
items.note: Code-first PyTorch deep learning. Videos and book prose are link-only; the fastbook notebooks are GPL-3.0.

items.title: LLM Course
items.note: Transformers, tokenizers, fine-tuning, the Hub and a chapter track through modern LLM practice, with Apache-licensed notebooks.

items.title: Agents Course
items.note: Agents from the thought-action-observation loop through frameworks, use cases and a final project with a free certificate.

items.title: Dive into Deep Learning
items.note: University-grade interactive book with runnable notebooks for every architecture; adopted at hundreds of universities.

items.title: Dive into Deep Learning — Chinese edition (zh.d2l.ai)
items.note: The strong Chinese-language edition of Dive into Deep Learning, under the same open license.

items.title: mlcourse.ai
items.note: A ten-week open machine-learning course with assignments and Kaggle competitions. Non-commercial license.

items.title: Elements of AI
items.note: A gentle, non-technical introduction to AI from the University of Helsinki. Free to take, link only.

sections.title: Open and officially free books

items.title: Deep Learning

items.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning

items.title: The Elements of Statistical Learning

items.title: Probabilistic Machine Learning

items.title: Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction

items.title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
